# @toolsync/engine

[![NPM Version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@toolsync/engine)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@toolsync/engine) [![Homepage](https://img.shields.io/badge/docs-default)](https://toolsync.vercel.app)

<!-- #endregion header -->

## Usage

> [!NOTE]
> If you're using `@toolsync/core`, you'll probably want to use the engine from there instead.

**Usage example:**

```ts
import { createEngine } from '@toolsync/engine';

// The engine is pretty useless without any plugins
class MyPlugin extends EnginePlugin {
  pluginName = 'my-plugin' as const;

  // Plugin implementation here
  doSomething() {
    console.log('Doing something!');
  }
}

// Create the engine with your plugins
const engine = createEngine({
  plugins: [
    // Your plugins here
    MyPlugin,
  ],
});

// Use the engine and its plugins
engine.plugins['my-plugin'].doSomething();
```
